text:
hana: spotted tenant usage leak on console. tenant 'delta' shows spike at 14:03 but traces point to 'echo'. UI quota graph and billing both affected.

omar: any repro? headers used?

hana: simple curl: `-H 'X-Tenant-ID: echo'` to internal-api -> enqueued id=e_99. internal-api logs show tenant=echo at enqueue; telemetry-worker shows processed tenant="".

jin: we recently switched to compact envelope encoding in event-queue (v2) which canonicalizes headers. whitelist trimmed unknown headers. x-tenant-id may have been dropped.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: event-queue v2 canary deploy at 2024-01-10T14:00Z.

omar: mitigation: (1) hotfix whitelist to accept x-tenant-id, (2) better: copy tenant into envelope body on enqueue so downstream doesn't rely on headers.

hana: prefer copying into body + small whitelist patch. also find processed envelopes with empty tenant to backfill.

jin: opening PR for payload copy + tests. will canary and run targeted backfill. tagging billing and support.

amar: adding rollout checklist item to ensure tenant propagation test in future.

hana: thanks — will update when backfill completes.
